description: Defines the Parser class for extracting and sanitizing referer and user agent information from HTTP requests, including internal/external referer categorization and subdomain handling.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing user agent and referer information from HTTP requests, with sanitization and internal/external categorization.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input text by removing special characters and unsupported UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: getUA
methods.description: Extracts user agent information from the request headers.

methods.name: getReferer
methods.description: Extracts and categorizes referer information, handling internal/external distinctions and subdomain considerations.
